from_node.description: Dasein understands/projects itself in terms of possibilities.

to_node.description: This existential projection is treated as a condition for a mode of disclosed possibility, not as causal production of Being simpliciter.

bridge.statement: Existential projection enables disclosed possibilities for Dasein; any move from access/disclosure to Being simpliciter needs a separate bridge.

scale_check.bridge_burden: Block existential possibility → universal modality/ontology without independent support.

rivals.description: Read Möglichkeit as a Dasein-specific existential structure rather than a universal modal operator.
rivals.discriminator: Ask whether projection determines the disclosed possibility or only opens access to it.

em4.alternative_access: Other modal vocabularies may describe logical or nomological possibility without Dasein-specific projection.
em4.revision_trigger: Independent evidence that the claimed condition governs being simpliciter rather than Dasein's disclosed possibilities.

audit_semantics.relation_rationale: Projection opens or enables disclosed possibilities without being encoded as their sufficient cause, production or metaphysical ground.
review_notes: RT04 was replaced by RT05 because the record asserts enabling access rather than a fully specified necessary/sufficient condition.
